🚀
 **Lead Functional Consultant – Banking Transformation** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Trivandrum
 



 🏢

 Initially Office\-Based \| Minimum 3 Days/Week Hybrid after transition
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 10 \- 16yrs
 



 🏦

 Banking / Financial Technology
 



 Qualification: Degree/PG from Reputed institutions
 



 Working experience from BIG 4 companies is preferred.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Lead Functional Consultant** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Banking Transformation** 
 to work closely with banking clients, understand complex business challenges, and design scalable, business\-driven solutions.
 



 This is
 **not a traditional requirements\-gathering role** 
 . We are looking for a strategic consultant who can
 **lead discovery, challenge assumptions, design solutions, and drive execution** 
 .
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Lead discovery sessions and consulting discussions with banking clients
 



 • Understand business processes, pain points, and strategic objectives
 



 • Translate business requirements into scalable functional solutions
 



 • Facilitate workshops with business, technology, and product stakeholders
 



 • Provide functional expertise across
 **Product \& Pricing, Rates \& Fees, Billing, Offers, Deposits \& Payments, and Relationship Pricing** 




 • Develop functional architecture and detailed solution specifications
 



 • Configure products, pricing, rates, fees, rules, and parameters
 



 • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams
 



 • Support
 **SIT, UAT, and Production Readiness** 




 • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders
 



  





 Key Requirements
 



 ✅ Strong experience in
 **Retail, Corporate, or Commercial Banking** 




 ✅ Proven experience in
 **Banking Transformation / Consulting** 




 ✅ Strong expertise in
 **Product, Pricing, Rates, Fees and/or Billing** 




 ✅ Experience leading
 **client discovery sessions and workshops** 




 ✅ Excellent problem\-solving and consulting capabilities
 



 ✅ Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills
 



 ✅ Ability to translate complex business problems into practical solutions
 



 ✅ Strong hands\-on functional and solution design experience
 



  





 Advantage
 



 Experience with
 **Temenos, Finastra, Oracle Banking, FIS, or Fiserv** 
 will be an added advantage.
 



  





 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 Professionals from
 **leading banking consulting/strategy practices, core banking technology companies, fintech organizations, or large\-scale banking transformation programs** 
 are highly preferred.
